sources.snippet: This AI created Model is based of from Ariana Grande's fictional character "Cat Valentine" from Nickelodeon's TV show hit "Victorious". I made it clean as possible, since most of the dataset used is based from filtered isolated vocals from the actual show (basically taken random clips from episodes, and putting it together).
